title: Dashcam Shows Ohio Cop Disarm Young Boy Armed With 2 Knives
description:
** (Disclaimer: This video content is intended for educational and informational purposes only) **
Newly-released video from the Grove City police shows an officer grabbing a young boy and disarming him, right after the child put a knife to his own throat. The video was released by Grove City police Wednesday morning, after the Monday night incident near the Dollar Tree store on Hoover Road.
